question: Should TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND and isToolProgressPayload become the permanent public Plugin SDK contract for producer-to-channel progress intent?
rationale: A typed cross-plugin seam is architecturally preferable to Slack text inference, but adding callable public SDK surface is a lasting compatibility choice that needs explicit owner intent.

options.title: Approve the generic SDK seam
options.body: Keep the generic constant and predicate, document their stable meaning, and require channel transports to preserve the metadata through rendering.

options.title: Keep the contract internal
options.body: Replace the public exports with a narrower internal or injected runtime contract before merging.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic SDK seam
recommendation.body: Keep the generic constant and predicate, document their stable meaning, and require channel transports to preserve the metadata through rendering.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recent merged-history overlap across both Slack native-data delivery and the public Plugin SDK reply-payload surface.
